To find the length of $\overline{AB},$ we use the distance formula:

\[ \eqalign{ AB &= \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{(3 - (-1))^2 + (-2 - 1)^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{(4)^2 + (-3)^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{16 + 9} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{25} \\[5pt] &= 5 } \]

From the figure, we note that the points $C$ and $D$ have coordinates $\underbrace{(7,1)}_{\text{($x_1$,$\;y_1)$}}$ and $\underbrace{(1,9)}_{\text{($x_2$,$\;y_2)$}},$ respectively.

To find the distance $CD,$ we can use the distance formula:

\begin{align*} CD &= \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{(1-7)^2 + (9-1)^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{(-6)^2 + 8^2} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{36 + 64} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt{100} \\[5pt] &= \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{10} \end{align*}
